verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developer.bigcommerce.com/llms.txt, and the file includes an explicit "Instructions for AI Agent" section. The developer portal also advertises AI-ready page actions, and docs pages are served as raw .md files (e.g. quick-start.md, tools-and-sdks.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents actually consume these docs effectively, and visibility into the full depth of the llms.txt content beyond its header.
